verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at inference-docs.cerebras.ai that indexes the docs as markdown links. The docs pages are served as .md files, and each one points agents back to the llms.txt index. Many capability pages (tool use, streaming, structured outputs, batch, and others) are available at .md URLs, giving agents clean, fetchable docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or first-party guidance on agent-oriented doc consumption, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404).
